lines: lu001e“萧诺，你身为萧家子嗣，该是为家族作出贡献的时候了。”
“天罡剑宗的少宗主需要你体内的那滴天凰血成就战凰圣体，只要你愿意交出天凰血，天罡剑宗便可护佑我们家族三百年。”
“别做无谓的抵抗，为了家族，你这个小小的牺牲，又算得了什么呢？嘿嘿嘿。”
“牺牲你一个萧诺，成全整个家族，这可是求都求不来的好事，哈哈哈哈。”
“来人，取血。”
冰冷的刀刃随即贯入了背骨当中，渗透灵魂的剧烈痛感直接是把萧诺从睡梦中惊醒。
萧诺满头大汗，大口的喘着粗气。
“又是这个梦……”
萧诺双手紧握成拳，指甲都陷入了掌心肉中，他的眼神中，涌动着火焰般的憎恨以及愤怒。
三年了，三年前的那一晚，仿佛成为了萧诺永远都挥之不去的梦魇。
萧诺出生于“蜥月城”
的萧氏家族。
在他出生那天，天生异象，身外赤金之气萦绕，经过查验，其体内竟有一滴“天凰圣血”
凭借精血之力，他在同辈人中，出类拔萃，风采斐然，曾经更是蜥月城排名第一的天才。
可就在三年前……
天罡剑宗和萧家做了一笔交易，剑宗要“天凰血”
转接给他们的少宗主，助其修炼千年战凰圣体。
为此，天罡剑宗给萧家开出了非常丰厚的条件，甚至给出了一句承诺：只要交出天凰血，天罡剑宗愿护萧家三百年！
天罡剑宗乃是东荒七大修行圣地之一，在世人的心中，绝对是一尊庞然大物。
只要得到天罡剑宗的庇护，萧氏家族，崛起在望。
正是因为那句承诺，萧家之主令人强行取走了萧诺身上的那滴“天凰血”
天罡剑宗得到了天凰血，也遵守了承诺，不仅给予了萧家天大的好处，甚至还把萧家的年轻一辈招入了宗门修行。
近几年，萧家发展的很快，一跃成为了蜥月城排名前三的家族。
可是被夺走天凰血的萧诺，功体受到重创，一夜之间，从高楼坠入了深渊。
耳边的称赞，全部变成了乌有，曾经的拥簇，尽数化为了冷眼。
悲愤！
不甘！
痛苦！
绝望！

lu001e "Xiao Nuo, as a descendant of the Xiao family, it's time for you to contribute to the family."
"The young master of the Tiangang Sword Sect needs the drop of Heavenly Phoenix blood in your body to become the Holy Body of the War Phoenix. As long as you are willing to hand over the Heavenly Phoenix blood, the Tiangang Sword Sect can protect our family for three hundred years."
"Don't resist needlessly. For the sake of the family, what does your small sacrifice mean? Hehehehe."
"Sacrifice you, Xiao Nuo, to help the whole family. This is a good thing that you can't even ask for, hahahaha."
"Come here, take the blood."
"Hiss!"
"..."
"No!"
The cold blade immediately penetrated into the back bone, and the severe pain that penetrated the soul directly woke Xiao Nuo from his sleep.
"Phew!"
Xiao Nuo was sweating profusely and breathing heavily.
"It's this dream again..."
Xiao Nuo clenched his hands into fists, his nails digging into the flesh of his palms. His eyes were filled with flaming hatred and anger.
It has been three years, and that night three years ago seems to have become a nightmare that Xiao Nuo will never get rid of.
Xiao Nuo was born in "Lizard Moon City"
The Xiao family.
On the day he was born, he was born with a strange phenomenon, and the aura of red gold lingered outside his body. After examination, it was found that there was a drop of "Holy Blood of the Heavenly Phoenix" in his body.
With the power of his essence and blood, he stood out among his peers and had a brilliant demeanor. He was once the number one genius in Lizard Moon City.
But just three years ago...
The Tiangang Sword Sect made a deal with the Xiao family, and the Sword Sect wanted "Tianhuang Blood"
Transferred to their young sect leader to help him cultivate the Thousand Years War Phoenix Holy Body.
For this reason, the Tiangang Sword Sect offered very generous conditions to the Xiao family, and even made a promise: As long as the blood of Tianhuang is handed over, the Tiangang Sword Sect is willing to protect the Xiao family for three hundred years!
The Tiangang Sword Sect is one of the seven holy places of cultivation in the Eastern Wasteland. In the hearts of the world, it is definitely a giant.
As long as they get the protection of the Tiangang Sword Sect, the Xiao family is expected to rise.
It was precisely because of that promise that the head of the Xiao family had the drop of "Celestial Phoenix Blood" taken away from Xiao Nuo's body.
The Tiangang Sword Sect received the blood of the Heavenly Phoenix and kept its promise. Not only did it provide the Xiao family with great benefits, it even recruited the younger generation of the Xiao family into the sect to practice.
In recent years, the Xiao family has developed rapidly and has become one of the top three families in Lizhiyue City.
However, Xiao Nuo, who had the blood of Tianhuang taken away from him, suffered severe physical damage and fell from a tall building into an abyss overnight.
All the compliments in his ears turned into nothing, and all the support he once had turned into cold looks.
Sad and angry!
Not willing to give in!
pain!
despair!
